title: Kissed Argentinian Grilled Bread
description: Pungent, bouncy-qq, festive Argentinian dish featuring white bread mix, nimono-simmer, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients. Best served warm and fresh.

ingredients.name: white bread mix
ingredients.notes: preferably made with spelt or kamut flour

ingredients.name: ayurvedic-sattvic seasonings
ingredients.notes: make sure they are vegan and gluten-free

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium heat.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Dip each slice of bread into the oil mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place the bread slices on the grill and cook for 2 minutes on each side, or until slightly charred.
Brush the bread with some of the nimono simmer while still warm.
Garnish with chopped parsley and a pinch of salt.
